requirements.condition: Encoding the ADDRESS field of A-record RDATA.
requirements.required_behavior: Encode ADDRESS as a 32-bit Internet address.
requirements.why_checkable: The ADDRESS field width and Internet-address encoding can be inspected in the RDATA serializer and parser.

requirements.quote:
Hosts that have multiple Internet addresses will have multiple A
records.
requirements.condition: A host has multiple Internet addresses.
requirements.required_behavior: Represent the host's multiple Internet addresses with multiple A records.
requirements.why_checkable: A host with multiple configured Internet addresses can be checked for representation by multiple A records.

requirements.quote: A records cause no additional section processing.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Perform additional-section processing as a consequence of the A record.
requirements.why_checkable: The A-record processing path can be checked for whether it triggers additional-section processing.

requirements.quote:
The RDATA section of
an A line in a master file is an Internet address expressed as four
decimal numbers separated by dots without any imbedded spaces (e.g.,
"10.2.0.52" or "192.0.5.6").
requirements.condition: Representing the RDATA of an A line in a master file.
requirements.required_behavior: Express the Internet address as exactly four numbers.
requirements.why_checkable: The master-file A-record address representation has a directly countable number of components.

requirements.quote:
The RDATA section of
an A line in a master file is an Internet address expressed as four
decimal numbers separated by dots without any imbedded spaces (e.g.,
"10.2.0.52" or "192.0.5.6").
requirements.condition: Representing the RDATA of an A line in a master file.
requirements.required_behavior: Express each of the four Internet-address numbers in decimal.
requirements.why_checkable: The numeric base used for each master-file A-record address component can be checked.

requirements.quote:
The RDATA section of
an A line in a master file is an Internet address expressed as four
decimal numbers separated by dots without any imbedded spaces (e.g.,
"10.2.0.52" or "192.0.5.6").
requirements.condition: Representing the RDATA of an A line in a master file.
requirements.required_behavior: Separate the four Internet-address numbers with dots.
requirements.why_checkable: The master-file A-record address delimiters can be inspected and compared with the required dot characters.

requirements.quote:
The RDATA section of
an A line in a master file is an Internet address expressed as four
decimal numbers separated by dots without any imbedded spaces (e.g.,
"10.2.0.52" or "192.0.5.6").
requirements.condition: Representing the RDATA of an A line in a master file.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Include embedded spaces within the Internet-address representation.
requirements.why_checkable: The master-file A-record address representation can be checked for internal space characters.
